description: Annual Parking Study Data is a dataset listed in City of Seattle open data portal (cos-data.seattle.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Seattle. Manual parking study details from citywide paid parking study, presented by blockface and date/hour of study. Most data is from spring of each year, with some data sets including summer studies. Coverage: Seattle. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking, occupancy, manual study, disabled parking, parking pricing program. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Seattle. The portal shows 2019-11-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-cos-data-seattle-gov-portal.
